surface-canvas.description: Application canvas behind the document: the desk color of the review page.

surface-paper.description: The document paper every accepted text is read on.

surface-raised.description: Cards, controls, menus, and dialogs raised above the canvas.

surface-rail.description: The annotation rail and other secondary, sunken fills.

scrim.description: The modal mask painted behind an open dialog.

text-on-accent.description: Text and glyphs drawn on the accent or danger fill.

border.description: The default rule, separator, and control outline.

border-strong.description: An emphasized outline, such as a scrollbar thumb or active control.

accent.description: The single action and focus color: primary buttons, links, selection.

comment.description: Comment anchors, comment balloons, and pending comment counts.

suggestion.description: Suggestion anchors, insertion marks, and suggestion balloons.

danger.description: Destructive actions, deletions, and failed states.

shadow.description: The shadow color mixed with transparency by elevation rules.

font-ui.description: Interface text: controls, labels, and chrome.

font-reading.description: The document reading face. Hosts may map their content font here.

font-size.description: The interface base size. The reading paper keeps its own larger scale.

radius-card.description: Cards, balloons, and the paper sheet.

artwork.note: Agent identity colors are artwork, not theme tokens: they name a person, not a surface.
